svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 80 mm lengths of 4 mm 316 rod; square the top ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind a point on the other end: about 4 mm long, tip about 0.6 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Abrade the top 15 mm, tin it with stainless-steel flux and solder a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.25 mm2 wire to it (or crimp in a 4 mm splice); wash off the flux.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide a 5 mm length of 4 mm heat-shrink to sit just below the fin foot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (15 to 20 mm from the top end) and shrink it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: top 15 mm in the foot grooves, 24 mm apart, set in epoxy when the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: halves are glued; 5 mm sleeved, then 60 mm bare below the foot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: bare length 60 mm on each rod (it sets the EC cell constant);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no flux left on the bare length.
